summary: Vista Energy filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine open-market repurchase of 50,000 Series A shares at MXN 1,181.40 per share, totaling approximately MXN 59.07 million. The buyback was executed by Citi México Casa de Bolsa under authorization from the April 28, 2026 shareholders' meeting. Post-repurchase, 111,167,402 Series A shares remained outstanding, with 1,134,351 in treasury. This is a routine capital return via issuer tender/open-market repurchase, not a special situation such as a tender offer or going-private transaction. No premium, board recommendation, or unusual terms are disclosed.
